options.title: Hydraulic Balance — settings
options.description: The balancing runs in cycles: all rooms heat at the same time, heat-up rates are compared and the maximum valve opening degrees are adjusted.

data.autoset: Automatically write results to the thermostats

room.title: Add a room
room.description: Pick the thermostat, a room temperature sensor and optionally the number entity controlling the maximum valve opening degree (e.g. Sonoff TRVZB "valve_opening_degree_max" via Zigbee2MQTT).

data.name: Room name (e.g. Living room)
data.max_opening_number: Number entity for max. opening degree (optional)

error.entity_missing: This entity does not exist (or is unavailable).

data.autoset: Automatically write results to the thermostats

start.name: Start balancing
start.description: Starts the balancing run: measurement cycles followed by opening-degree adjustments.

stop.name: Stop balancing
stop.description: Aborts the current run and restores original setpoints and opening degrees.

reset_learning.name: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Resets all learned opening degrees back to 100 %.
